svg.text: Editable schematic reconstructed from the repaired PCB • 29 components • 19 named nets
Net names are copied literally from the PCB; this board does not contain a voltage regulator.
FH1: fuse rating is not specified by the PCB. “3V” elsewhere is also a literal net name.
U3 and U4 are separate 1×20 headers, not an assumed MCU pinout.
“open” = no net or copper connection on the source PCB.
No no-connect flags were added; confirm intent before changing these pins.
Each output keeps its existing signal / +SV / GND pin order. Motors and controller are off-board.
Reference names and pin assignments are retained exactly, including the name BICEP1.
BICEP1 carries CLK / 3V / GND; it is not the S2 / +SV / GND servo connector named BICEP.
Supplier symbols confirm LED pin 1 = anode, pin 2 = cathode.
An as-wired companion to the PCB, not a recovered original schematic.
All component IDs, footprint UUIDs, pad numbers and named nets are retained.
FH1 has four physical pads but only two electrical terminals (1 and 2).
The PCB export does not define external module circuitry or supply limits.
Do not treat a netlist match or manufacturing DRC as circuit approval.
Open the JSON in EasyEDA Standard; see the import notes before Update PCB.
